app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing and Valkey as cart store. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails

Pod logs contain continuous INFO-level entries showing normal operation (e.g., 'Requesting quote' to http://quote:8080/getquote, 'Sending Quote', 'Tracking ID Created') up through 2026-10-05T22:50:00Z.

An ECONNREFUSED observed to ClusterIP 10.96.101.67:8080 (as referenced in the diagnosis) is therefore unlikely to be caused by the shipping pod process itself; the failure is more consistent with a networking/service-layer problem (ClusterIP, kube-proxy, iptables/routing, or transient connectivity) or service misrouting rather than an application bind failure.
The pod was actively making outbound calls to the quote service (http://quote:8080/getquote), indicating application-level outgoing networking is working from the pod.

Recommendation (inferred): next investigation steps should focus on the ClusterIP/service plane and node-level networking (inspect Service object, endpoints, kube-proxy, iptables/nft rules, and any networking errors) since the pod process is healthy.
